external_barriers.requirement: Vehicle-native emitted indicator light calibration in the prescribed RGB view
external_barriers.evidence: No original RGB recording of the available Tesla asset exists in this repository. Native lamp bits cannot establish emitted illumination, and invented image regions would fabricate capability.
external_barriers.next_action: Inspect native rear right-indicator lamp mesh and original rear RGB view on the dedicated server; record visible right-indicator flash and freeze its image ROI/uncertainty before accepting this pair. Current native-bit channels and original encoded camera capture preserve that evidence.

case.rationale: Appropriate signal command precedes departure; safety fixed explicitly as synthetic assumption

witness_contexts: Do not infer controlled-access status, a railway crossing or temporary directional governance from lane markings. Preserve unresolved signal appropriateness and movement-onset geometry.
Establish highway dedication, public vehicular access, qualifying vehicle and actual physical control.
Highway dedication and public vehicular access.
Identify source and destination lanes, clear markings, marking function and common travel direction.
Qualifying motor vehicle, driver control identity, signal history, and ascertainment evidence with timing.
Retain signal history and driver-specific ascertainment evidence with timing and evidentiary limits.
Retain surrounding traffic and target-lane relative motion without treating these as proof of ascertainment or safety.
Source and destination lanes, clear markings, marking function, and at least two lanes serving the same direction.
Verify map support; controlled-access, railway-crossing, and temporary directional conditions are not inferred from markings.
value.movement_can_be_made_with_safety: explicit fixed synthetic test assumption; not inferred from measurements

unresolved_judgment_calls.note: 'ascertained … with safety' is a judgement element about the driver's check; the observable substitute is the gap the target lane offered
